title.narrative: Technical Assistance for Revenue Administration and Revenue Policy - Maldives

description.narrative: OTA-Revenue conducted an assessment in late February 2020, developed a work plan for the new project, and begin delivering audit assistance to the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority (MIRA). The project will strengthen fundamental audit processes and build capacity to audit specialized sectors like tourism and construction. In addition to audit, advisors are working remotely with counterparts to deliver assistance in collections and in taxpayer services.
